1.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

4.text: From the evil of the retreating whisperer<sup foot_note="228304">1</sup> -

footnotes.228304: - i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.

5.text: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

6.text: From among the jinn and mankind."<sup foot_note="228305">1</sup>

footnotes.228305: - Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.
